description: K₃NaBe₂F₈ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.56-3.07 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form distorted KF₆ cuboctahedra that share corners with six equivalent BeF₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. All K-F bond lengths are 2.91 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BeF₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent KF₆ cuboctahedra. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.28 Å. Be is bonded to four F atoms to form BeF₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent KF₆ cuboctahedra and corners with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 16°. There is one shorter (1.52 Å) and three longer (1.58 Å) Be-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K and one Be atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Be atom.
